source_label: Stored supplied-original JOHNWALK frame 016; no Cartoon or HD-derived geometry.

original_frame.landmark_limit: Visible bounds include original shadow; first-row extent is a measured pixel feature, not an engine or anatomical anchor.

scope: Copied and validated preserved original extraction. Commercial RESOURCE files and original executable were not reread or rerun in this step.
palette_limit: Original indices use the port dump palette and index 0 transparency. Original executable color/compositing and timing parity are not established.
hash_policy: Exact file bytes for stored records and PNGs; RGBA hashes cover decoded row-major RGBA bytes.

nearest8.verification: All decoded RGBA bytes equal native pixel replication into 8x8 blocks.

registration.target_basis: X is the original top-row cap-outline midpoint at 2x. Y=0.25 is the inherited deliberate filter margin, not a measured original point. No engine or anatomical anchor is claimed.

pose_observations.view: Front-facing heading 0/S, chest and pelvis toward viewer; not the oblique 017 stance.
pose_observations.arms: Both elbows extend outward; forearms return to hands at the waist/shorts pocket sides. No lowered walking arm.
pose_observations.legs_feet: Stationary separated legs with outward-directed feet. Preserve modest perspective asymmetry rather than forcing mirror symmetry or one artificial contact line.

indicative_colored_foot_pixels.mask: y>=60, x=[0,16) versus x=[16,32), exact RGBA colors (252,0,0,255), (252,252,252,255), (168,168,0,255); excludes gray shadow and black outline.
indicative_colored_foot_pixels.limit: Colored pixel extents are not anatomical soles, leg identity or a measured ground plane.

pose_observations.shadow_limit: Original gray shadow contributes to visible bounds and canvas bottom; do not align generated feet to it.
pose_observations.anatomical_identity_limit: No hidden anatomical left/right limb identity has been assigned.

adjacency.scope: Retained compiled C state-machine observations, not a new native capture. Runtime tick 20ms gives 120ms intermediate draws and 1600ms final waits.
